sources.title: Paraguay MFA: visa requirements by country
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Paraguay
sources.officialityEvidence: The Paraguayan MFA's live country-requirements page publishes a closed no-visa list and expressly states the rule for a country absent from that list.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Si su país no figura en el listado, usted SÍ requiere visa para ingresar al Paraguay.

sources.title: Paraguay MFA: visas
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Paraguay
sources.officialityEvidence: The MFA's live visa service explains that the digital application is reviewed by a Paraguayan consular office and proceeds to a consular interview, rather than electronically issuing the visa.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Posteriormente, se le comunicará una fecha y horario para acudir a la entrevista ante la oficina consular

sources.title: Paraguay National Migration Directorate: January 2026 tourist-visa schedule
sources.officialityEvidence: The National Migration Directorate's official January 2026 PDF schedule directly names Mongolia and its tourist-entry outcome; it was accessible on the Directorate's live domain during review.
sources.supportingExcerpt: MONGOLIA LEY N° 7206/17/11/2023 NO REQUIERE VISA: para permanencia de hasta 90 días

policies.title: Unlisted ordinary passports: Paraguay advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Paraguay MFA's current closed no-visa list expressly requires a visa for an unlisted country; its ordinary visitor procedure is reviewed and completed through a Paraguayan consular office before travel.
conditions: Each listed passport is absent from the MFA's current closed no-visa list; no status is derived from a migration-table omission or another nationality.
The standard tourist route requires digital filing followed by consular review and a notified consular interview before travel; it is an advance visa, not an eVisa.
MFA's separate exceptional arrival process requires a justified case, an inviter and prior Ministry approval. It is not an unconditional nationality-wide visa-on-arrival route.
Work, residence, study, transit, special passports, qualifying third-country documents and final admission are excluded.

conflicts.explanation: The MFA's closed no-visa list omits Mongolia and expressly requires a visa for an unlisted country, while the National Migration Directorate's official January 2026 schedule gives Mongolia a 90-day tourist waiver. The directly conflicting current authorities do not establish one baseline.

unresolved.reason: The National Migration Directorate's official January 2026 schedule directly grants Mongolia a 90-day tourist waiver, while the MFA's closed no-visa list omits Mongolia and says an unlisted country requires a visa. The official conflict is not normalized.
